title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Mahila Co-operative Bank Ltd., Bangalore, Karnataka
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated June 11, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹5 lakh (Rupees Five Lakh only) on Mahila Co-operative Bank Ltd., Bangalore, Karnataka (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Loans and advances to directors, their relatives, and firms / concerns in which they are interested’.
